description: This file contains functions for measuring text dimensions, normalizing text, and handling text metrics within the Excalidraw project. It includes utilities for calculating text width, height, line height, and character widths, with support for custom text metrics providers.

classes.name: CanvasTextMetricsProvider
classes.description: A class implementing TextMetricsProvider that uses an HTML canvas element to measure text width, with special handling for test environments.

methods.name: measureText
methods.description: Calculates the width and height of a given text string based on font and line height.

methods.name: getApproxMinLineWidth
methods.description: Estimates the minimum line width for text based on maximum character width and padding.

methods.name: getMinTextElementWidth
methods.description: Calculates the minimum width of a text element based on font and line height.

methods.name: isMeasureTextSupported
methods.description: Checks if measuring text width is supported in the current environment.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Normalizes text by converting end-of-line characters and replacing tabs with spaces.

methods.name: detectLineHeight
methods.description: Detects the line height of a text element based on its height and number of lines.

methods.name: getLineHeightInPx
methods.description: Calculates line height in pixels from font size and line height ratio.

methods.name: setCustomTextMetricsProvider
methods.description: Sets a custom provider for measuring text metrics.

methods.name: getLineWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a line of text using the current text metrics provider.

methods.name: getTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum width among all lines of the given text.

methods.name: getTextHeight
methods.description: Calculates the total height of the text block based on line count and line height.

methods.name: getMinCharWidth
methods.description: Returns the minimum character width for a given font.

methods.name: getMaxCharWidth
methods.description: Returns the maximum character width for a given font.
